decisive_items: a solitary, completely cystic mass in the left L5–S1 foraminal zone extending along the course of the sciatic nerve
The lesion was hypointense on T1-weighted images, hyperintense on T2-weighted images, and demonstrated peripheral rim enhancement
response.rationale: R1 is supported by more specific imaging characteristics and location of the mass, consistent with a schwannoma, while R2 lacks these specific details

rejected.why: C1 is an append-only completion of R1 and does not provide sufficient distinct evidence to stand alone
